summary.note: Synthetic provenance/integrity tests only; they say nothing about detecting visual manipulation in real satellite imagery.

results.description: Manifest latitude edited after signing.
reasons: SIG_INVALID: Ed25519 signature does not verify against the manifest

results.description: Claims sat-alpha-2026a but signed with the attacker's key.
reasons: SIG_INVALID: Ed25519 signature does not verify against the manifest

results.description: Correctly signed by sat-rogue-99, which is not in the trust store. Sensor exists elsewhere in the store, so metadata is valid.
reasons: KEY_UNKNOWN: key_id 'sat-rogue-99' is not in the trust store

results.description: Mathematically valid signature from the revoked key sat-alpha-2025x.
reasons: KEY_REVOKED: key 'sat-alpha-2025x' has status 'revoked'

results.description: New picture reusing the already-accepted image_id scene_099.
reasons: REPLAY_ID: image_id 'scene_099' was already accepted

results.description: Fresh image_id, but the bytes of the picture accepted as scene_099.
reasons: REPLAY_CONTENT: identical image bytes were already accepted

results.description: Valid signature; latitude out of range and sensor not allowed for the key.
reasons: META_LATITUDE: latitude 123.4 is not a number in [-90, 90]
META_SENSOR: sensor 'SAT-UNKNOWN' not allowed for key 'sat-alpha-2026a'

results.description: Observation 100 h old (limit 72 h).
reasons: META_TIME_STALE: observation is 100.0 h old, limit 72 h

results.description: 60-byte text file renamed to .png; manifest and signature consistent with it.
reasons: FORMAT_MAGIC: magic bytes 517561727465726c do not match .png

results.description: Image and manifest present, no .manifest.sig file.
reasons: SIG_MISSING: detached signature file not found

results.description: Zero-byte .png (below policy.min_file_size_bytes).
results.spec_reference: guide 10 stretch goal: reject empty files -> FORMAT_SIZE (documented choice)
reasons: FORMAT_SIZE: file size 0 B outside [1, 104857600] B

results.description: PNG cut to 60 % of its length; header parses, full decode fails.
reasons: FORMAT_DECODE: full decode failed: OSError: image file is truncated

results.description: Valid BMP image; bmp is not in allowed_formats.
reasons: FORMAT_EXTENSION: extension '.bmp' not in allowed_formats ['jpg', 'png', 'tif']

results.description: Correct PNG magic followed by random bytes; the image library cannot open it.
results.spec_reference: guide 4.1 'image library reports the same format' -> FORMAT_DECODE
reasons: FORMAT_DECODE: image library cannot open file as ('PNG',): UnidentifiedImageError: cannot identify image file <_io.BytesIO object>

results.description: Normal PNG (several KB) assessed with max_file_size_mb = 0.001 (~1 KB) to avoid a 100 MB fixture.
reasons: FORMAT_SIZE: file size 10229 B outside [1, 1048] B

results.description: Decodable 7000x6000 (42 Mpx) 1-bit PNG, a few KB on disk; limit is 40 Mpx.
reasons: FORMAT_DIMENSIONS: 7000x6000 = 42000000 px exceeds max_pixels 40000000

results.description: Tiny PNG whose IHDR claims 100000x100000 px; must be rejected from the header.
reasons: FORMAT_DIMENSIONS: decompression bomb guard: DecompressionBombError: Image size (10000000000 pixels) exceeds limit of 178956970 pixels, could be decompression bomb DOS attack.

results.description: Real JPEG saved with a .png extension.
reasons: FORMAT_MAGIC: magic bytes ffd8ffe000104a46 do not match .png

results.description: Truncated, unparseable manifest JSON. No manifest object, so metadata cannot run (null).
reasons: MANIFEST_INVALID: manifest is not valid JSON: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 63 (char 62)

results.description: Validly signed manifest without the required 'nonce' field.
reasons: MANIFEST_INVALID: missing field 'nonce'

results.description: Validly signed manifest with manifest_version 2.
reasons: MANIFEST_INVALID: manifest_version must be 1, got 2

results.description: Manifest text repeats the image_id key with two values; ambiguous, so rejected.
results.spec_reference: implementation hardening (documented): duplicate JSON keys -> MANIFEST_INVALID
reasons: MANIFEST_INVALID: manifest is not valid JSON: ValueError: duplicate JSON key 'image_id'

results.description: No manifest file at all.
reasons: MANIFEST_INVALID: manifest unreadable: No such file or directory

results.description: .sig file exists but is not valid base64.
results.spec_reference: guide 10 stretch goal; decoded in the verify step -> SIG_INVALID (documented choice)
reasons: SIG_INVALID: signature unusable: Error: Only base64 data is allowed

results.description: Valid base64 but only 32 bytes (an Ed25519 signature is 64).
reasons: SIG_INVALID: signature unusable: ValueError: decoded signature is 32 bytes, expected 64

results.description: Active key valid 2024-01-01..2025-01-01 used to sign on 2026-10-13.
Active key valid from 2027-01-01 used to sign on 2026-10-13.
signed_at is not ISO-8601, so it cannot be shown to lie in the key's validity period.
Validly signed manifest whose metadata lacks 'timestamp'.
reasons: META_MISSING_FIELD: missing metadata fields: ['timestamp']

results.description: Longitude 200.5 (range is +-180).
reasons: META_LONGITUDE: longitude 200.5 is not a number in [-180, 180]

results.description: Latitude given as the string "36.8" instead of a number.
reasons: META_LATITUDE: latitude '36.8' is not a number in [-90, 90]

results.description: Observation 1 h after the reference time (skew tolerance 300 s).
reasons: META_TIME_FUTURE: timestamp 2026-10-13T13:00:00Z is later than now 2026-10-13T12:00:00Z + 300 s

results.description: Observation 4 min after the reference time; inside the 300 s skew, so accepted.
Timestamp uses a space and no 'Z'.
reasons: META_TIME_INVALID: timestamp '2026-10-13 03:00:00' is not YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

results.description: Manifest names scene_038_original.png; the received file is scene_038.png.
reasons: META_FILENAME: manifest file_name 'scene_038_original.png' != actual 'scene_038.png'
